title: Geologic map of the Blacksburg South quadrangle, Cherokee County, South Carolina
citation: Nystrom, P.G., Jr., 2009, Geologic map of the Blacksburg South quadrangle, Cherokee County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-153, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Bedrock map sheet (OCR). Units listed under INNER PIEDMONT BELT, and the Blacksburg and Battleground Formations of the Kings Mountain sequence of Carolina terrane, are given that heading as group (inferred). Symbols recorded only where printed on the unit's line (Czgs matched by layout). Garnet size printed '| to 2 cm' (OCR digit) left out. Cross section A-A' (no vertical exaggeration) is interpretive with no drill holes; its face text is garbled; not recorded. No ages are printed in the unit descriptions. No references printed.
